description.value:
You have learned to channel magical energy through objects. The rules on spellcasting are in the Player's Handbook; below is how you use them with Artificer spells, which appear on the Artificer spell list.

Tools Required. You produce your Artificer spells through tools. You can use Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, or another kind of Artisan's Tools you are proficient with as a Spellcasting Focus, and you must have one of those focuses in hand when you cast an Artificer spell (the spell then has an M component).

Cantrips. You know two Artificer cantrips of your choice; @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAcidSplash]{Acid Splash} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrestidigi]{Prestidigitation} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of them with another Artificer cantrip. At Artificer levels 10 and 14, you learn another Artificer cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Artificer Features table.

Spell Slots. The Artificer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Prepared Spells of Level 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells you can cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Artificer spells; @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Cure Wounds} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGrease0000]{Grease} are recommended. The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Artificer levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Artificer Features table; whenever it increases, choose more Artificer spells until your list matches it. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. Spells that another Artificer feature makes always prepared don't count against this number, but they count as Artificer spells for you.

Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of them with other Artificer spells for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Artificer spells.
